member.summary: The enum indicates which simple operation shall be performed to the matrix before some complicated operation being executed to reduce time or space complexity.

There are two independent (orthogonal) cyclic unary operations:
add : unchecked( + + ) ==
bit-wise not: ~ == , ~(~) ==
As a result, the enum and the unchecked 32-bit integer addition forms an (algebraic) group.

member.name: M:Althea.Numerics.Complex`1.MyRegex
member.remarks:
Pattern explanation:
○ 1st capture group.
○ Match with 2 alternative expressions.
○ Match a sequence of expressions.
○ Match a character in the set [+-] atomically, optionally.
○ Match a Unicode digit greedily at least once.
○ Optional (greedy).
○ Match '.'.
○ Match a Unicode digit greedily at least once.
○ Match a sequence of expressions.
○ Match a character in the set [+-] atomically, optionally.
○ Match a Unicode digit greedily any number of times.
○ Match '.' atomically, optionally.
○ Match a Unicode digit greedily at least once.
○ Optional (greedy).
○ Match a character in the set [Ee].
○ Match a character in the set [+-] atomically, optionally.
